title: M5 stage 9: integer Mobius connectivity indicator
scope: Section3 exact integer divisor indicator; polynomial inclusion-exclusion and full counts remain separate

spec.name: M5.Connectivity.divisor_moebius
spec.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, ArithmeticFunction.moebius d) = if n = 1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0
spec.guidance: Rewrite the divisor sum using the reverse of ArithmeticFunction.coe_zeta_mul_apply, then coe_zeta_mul_moebius and one_apply. This is also true for n=0; no positivity assumption needed. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Connectivity.support_gcd_dvd
spec.statement: ∀ (N d : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), d ∣ M5.Connectivity.supportGcd N A B ↔ d ∣ N ∧ (∀ a ∈ A, d ∣ a) ∧ (∀ b ∈ B, d ∣ b)
spec.guidance: Unfold supportGcd, use Nat.dvd_gcd_iff and Finset.dvd_gcd_iff; id evaluates to identity. Preserve empty supports and zero exponents. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Connectivity.support_divisor_filter
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), 0 < N → N.divisors.filter (fun d => (∀ a ∈ A, d ∣ a) ∧ (∀ b ∈ B, d ∣ b)) = (M5.Connectivity.supportGcd N A B).divisors
spec.guidance: Extensionality plus Nat.mem_divisors and support_gcd_dvd. The support gcd divides positive N and hence is nonzero. Prove that auxiliary fact directly from Nat.gcd_dvd_left. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Connectivity.connected_indicator
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), 0 < N → (∑ d ∈ N.divisors, if (∀ a ∈ A, d ∣ a) ∧ (∀ b ∈ B, d ∣ b) then ArithmeticFunction.moebius d else 0) = if M5.Connectivity.supportGcd N A B = 1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0
spec.guidance: Change the sum with an if to a filtered sum using Finset.sum_filter. Rewrite by support_divisor_filter and divisor_moebius. This is the exact integer connectivity inclusion-exclusion indicator from section3, no polynomial claims yet. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve exact target.
